title: Train the Sampler You Run: Few-Step Masked Diffusion Language Models via Mixture-Likelihood Fine-Tuning
abstract: arXiv:2611.02666v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: When a masked diffusion language model is sampled in a few parallel steps in a random order, the model actually run is a mixture over reveal plans, while cross-entropy training fits token conditionals rather than this mixture. We introduce mixture-likelihood fine-tuning (Mix-FT), which fine-tunes a pretrained model on an importance-weighted bound of its own sampler's likelihood, with no teacher and no change to the architecture or the sampler. On LLaDA-8B, a LoRA fine-tune for 0.002% of the pretraining compute writes better OpenWebText continuations than continued cross-entropy and Alpha diffusion given the same compute, at every tested step count. With half the model evaluations, 16 rather than 32 steps per block, its continuations score better than the original model's in every seed under three judges, with confidence-based decoding as well as random order, and under confidence-based decoding two blinded LLM raters from different mod

translated_title: 训练你所运行的采样器：通过混合似然微调实现少步掩码扩散语言模型
translated_abstract: 当掩码扩散语言模型以随机顺序在少数并行步骤中进行采样时，实际运行的模型是对揭示计划的混合，而交叉熵训练拟合的是词元条件分布而非这种混合。我们提出混合似然微调，它在模型自身采样器似然的重要性加权界上对预训练模型进行微调，无需教师模型，也无需更改架构或采样器。在LLaDA-8B上，仅用预训练计算量的0.002%进行LoRA微调，所生成的OpenWebText续写在所有测试步数下均优于同等计算量下的持续交叉熵训练和Alpha扩散。在模型评估次数减半的情况下（每个块16步而非32步），在三种评判标准下，其续写得分在所有随机种子下均优于原始模型，无论采用置信度解码还是随机顺序；并且在置信度解码下，两位来自不同模[态的盲评LLM评审]……（原文在此处截断）
tldr: 提出混合似然微调方法，通过在模型自身采样器似然的重要性加权界上进行LoRA微调，使掩码扩散语言模型在少步采样下生成质量超越原始模型，且微调计算量仅为预训练的0.002%。
